definitions.short: to stretch a bow, as an archer
definitions.full: H2909. tachah [ טָחָה ] verb hurl, shoot (Late Hebrew id. ; Arabic spread, extend, carry far with , e.g. a ball Lane 1832c ) — only Pil. Participle (Ges § 75 R 18) plural construct קֶשֶׁת כִּמְטַחֲוֵי הַרְחֵק Gen 21:16 (E), literally making distant like shooters of a bow = about a bowshot off.
